I rescued my boy Rex from this pet shop , Rex is a mini Rex. I brought rex home at the beginning of January last year, little did we know that this pet shop actually let me take him home knowing that he had medical issues.
He has had endless counts of GI statsis, from the moment we brought him home. The vet even confirmed it was nothing that we did, I'm extremely experienced with rabbits.
Some blood tests later our vet told us that he has E.C which is a parasite that is deadly for buns. Not only that but he has had this since birth , which means the breeders this pet shop has been using were breeding rabbits that were not fit for sale. This now leads me to believe that regular health checks and vet visits were non existent.
Thankfully my boy Rex is now extremely taken care of , from the moment he entered our home he fit right in. I love him dearly. I'm just angry that he has suffered and the pet shop are saying they didn't notice anything wrong.
If you know anything about rabbits , then you'll know when something is wrong almost immediately. I don't think this pet shop should be allowed to sell any animals.
I made contact with kings heath pet centre about Rex's E.C infection on the 5th of December 2025 which I have proof of , the member of staff had asked me what breed and what date I made payment for Rex. I gave all relevant information to the member of staff who answered the phone. The response I got back was" we'll notify the breeders , thanks"
We have come to find out that Rex has other issues that stems from how he was bred and the lack of care that he received. Including teeth and kidney issues. Numerous rabbit/ exotic vets have stated that this was from a result of inbred breeding and inappropriate health care as well as other factors.
